Accounting Advisory Overview:
 
BPM’s Outsourced Accounting team calibrates financial and accounting processes and systems to meet the demands of today’s competitive business environment. We are uniquely positioned to help with a wide range of tax, assurance (GAAP, international standards, etc.), and financial support services.
 
More than a “vendor”, we serve as an extension of our client’s business. We know that our clients challenges are unique – our goal is to understand what those challenges are, and to explore the financial and operational opportunities available in order to customize the right solutions. Clients get the benefits of an enterprise solution without having to maintain one.
 
The CAAS Apprenticeship Program:
 
Our Apprenticeship program is designed for individuals with practical accounting experience who also have an interest in a career in outsourced accounting in a public accounting firm environment. The apprenticeship program is year-round and offers a flexible schedule with a minimum of 16 hours a week. The successful apprentice will “graduate” to Associate Level I (full-time) upon completion of the program.

- 1-2 years of applicable work or internship experience (preferably in a bookkeeper or accountant type role in an accounting department).

The Senior Manager will take meaningful ownership of engagements, exercise sound technical and professional judgment, develop the capabilities of our Bengaluru team, and work directly with BPM Partners, Directors and Managers in the United States.

Lead and Own Tax Engagements

- Take ownership of U.S. tax engagements from planning through completion, including workflow, staffing, budgets, deadlines, review and delivery.

- Manage multiple engagements and competing deadlines while maintaining a high standard of technical quality and client service.

- Review complex federal, state and local income tax returns and related workpapers.

- Identify technical and engagement issues early, research alternatives and recommend practical solutions.

- Exercise professional judgment in determining when matters can be resolved within the engagement team and when consultation or escalation is appropriate.

- Monitor engagement progress, economics and staffing needs and proactively address potential issues before they affect delivery.

- Help establish repeatable processes that allow greater portions of engagements to be effectively owned and managed from Bengaluru.

- Apply strong knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local tax requirements to complex engagements.

- Provide thoughtful review comments that improve both the immediate work product and the technical capabilities of the professionals completing the work.

- Research technical tax matters and clearly communicate conclusions and recommendations to engagement leadership.

- Stay current on relevant changes in U.S. tax law, regulations, guidance and firm methodology.

- Promote consistent application of BPM's quality standards, documentation requirements and risk-management practices.

- Identify opportunities to improve engagement processes, standardization and use of technology.

Develop and Lead People

- Lead, coach and develop Managers, Seniors and Associates within the Bengaluru tax practice.

- Build technical competence, confidence, judgment and accountability throughout the team.

- Provide timely, specific and constructive feedback rather than relying solely on review notes.

- Help team members understand not only what needs to be changed, but why it matters.

- Delegate effectively and expand responsibilities as team members demonstrate readiness.

- Participate in staffing, performance discussions, recruiting, onboarding and development of tax professionals.

- Help identify and develop future leaders for the Bengaluru practice.

Work as One Global Team

- Work directly with U.S.-based Partners, Directors and Managers as an integrated member of the engagement leadership team.

- Develop strong working relationships across locations, service teams and levels of the firm.

- Communicate engagement status, risks and issues clearly and early, accompanied whenever possible by a recommended solution.

- Participate confidently in engagement planning, technical discussions and appropriate client conversations.

- Ensure effective handoffs and coordination across time zones.

- Help U.S. and Bengaluru teams determine which responsibilities and workstreams can appropriately transition to greater Bengaluru ownership.

- Promote a culture in which global delivery is viewed as one engagement team with shared accountability for quality and client service.

- 10+ years of progressive U.S. tax experience, including substantial experience reviewing complex tax engagements.

- CPA, EA, CA or comparable professional credential mandatory.

- Strong technical knowledge of U.S. federal, state and local taxation.

- Demonstrated experience managing engagements from planning through delivery.

- Ability to manage staffing, workflow, deadlines, budgets and technical review across multiple engagements.

- Proven experience reviewing and developing the work of Managers, Seniors and Associates.

- Strong technical research, analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Sound professional judgment and the ability to distinguish between routine issues and matters requiring consultation or escalation.

- Ability to work directly and effectively with U.S.-based engagement leadership.

- A proactive mindset, with a demonstrated ability to anticipate problems and recommend solutions rather than simply respond to instructions or review comments.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex tax matters clearly.

- Experience working successfully across global teams and time zones.

- Demonstrated commitment to quality, client service, continuous improvement and professional development.
